entities.summary: The Doghmush family is a Palestinian clan from the Gaza Strip known for its long-running rivalry with Hamas. Nizar Doghmush is the de facto leader of the clan, while Mukhtar Doghmush was the leader of the clan’s northern branch. Mumtaz Doghmush was the historical leader of the clan.
